3408.title: ACP cancellation does not reach pending bridge calls
3408.rootCauseOneLine: The ACP MCP proxy drops cancellation notifications and later sends results to request IDs already abandoned by the client.
3408.proposedFix: Verify Cursor cancellation and propagate it through the bridge/runtime to the plugin abort signal.
3408.caveats: Real Cursor, its exact timeout, and BB form settlement were not exercised; repeated tests cover the actual MCP proxy with a TCP fixture.
